items.d: “인공지능(AI)이 저작권자의 허락 없이 콘텐츠를 사용해선 안 된다.” 팝스타 마돈나와 배우 로버트 드 니로 등 세계적인 스타들이 뉴욕타임스(NYT)와 오픈AI·마이크로소프트(MS)의 저작권 소송에 가세했다. AI 학습에 저작권이 있는 콘텐츠를 사용하는 게 적법한지를 둘러싼 법적 공방이 대중문화 전반으로 확대되는 양상이다. 미국 정치매체 액시오스는 3일(현지 시간) “영화와 음악, 방송, 문학 분야의 창작자와 관련 단체들이 최근 NYT와 오픈AI 등의 소송과 관련해 법원에 ‘법정조언자 의견서(amicus briefs)’를 잇달아 제출했다”고 전했다. 법정조언자 의견서란 소송 당사자는 아니지만 해당 판결에 법적 이해관계가 큰 제3자가 재판에 참고할 전문적 의견을 전달하는 문서다.해당 의견서는 대형 연예기획사

items.t: Meta Raises €9 Billion as Euro Bond Debut Draws Record Demand
items.d: Meta Platforms Inc. raised €9 billion from a debut euro debt bond sale that drew a record €53 billion of orders — the most for any corporate deal in Europe — after offering generous yields that even investors cautious about the AI boom found difficult to pass up.

items.fullText: Slice Into GFN Thursday: ‘Phantom Blade Zero’ Launches on GeForce NOW S-GAME’s kungfupunk action arrives at launch alongside nine games this week — plus, a ‘World of Warcraft: Forever’ reward is coming soon. October 29, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! This Halloween week, GFN Thursday is delivering a fresh batch of gaming treats. Something wicked this blade comes. S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero launches on GeForce NOW today, bringing a scarily good blend of martial arts and punk fantasy to the cloud. There’s also something on the horizon for adventurers: World of Warcraft: Forever arrives Wednesday, Nov. 4 at 3 p.m. PST, with a launch-week access reward coming for GeForce NOW members. This week’s lineup also includes nine games streaming from the GeForce NOW library , alongside new mod support for Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered . That means more options to play, with no downloads or installs to haunt gamers’ devices . There’s another sweet update for gamers in India: The option to sign up for four-month Performance and Ultimate memberships is launching tomorrow. Visit the GeForce NOW website for more information. Cold Steel Meets Cloud Power Framed for his master’s murder and gravely wounded, a warrior named Soul has 66 days to uncover a conspiracy threatening the martial world in S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero . Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the game combines wuxia storytelling with cinematic action. Master more than 30 primary weapons and over 20 Phantom Edges, chaining evasions, deflections and counterattacks into fluid combat. Traditional Chinese martial arts meet mechanical prosthetics, industrial ruins and rock music in a distinctive kungfupunk world. Ultimate members can wield GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud across PCs, Macs, handhelds, mobile devices, browsers, compatible TVs and more. items.t: Advocate for Elizabeth Holmes' innocence threatens to sue A24, Nathan Fielder over doc
items.d: New bombshell A24 documentary “You Can See Everything” draws backlash from a supporter of Elizabeth Holmes’ technology after clips of him were in the film, he says, without his permission. Now, he’s threatening to sue the filmmakers if they don't apologize. NBC News’ Chloe Melas reports.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 arrives on GeForce NOW at launch, bringing a new campaign, multiplayer action and DMZ, high-stakes extraction mode to supported devices . The campaign also gets an enhanced look: GeForce RTX 5080-class performance arrives for Ultimate members, bringing support for ray-tracing features in the cloud. There’s a new way to join the cloud, too: Existing supported Fire TV Stick users can now purchase one-month Performance or Ultimate memberships directly through Amazon, making it easier to sign up and start streaming on the big screen. Plus, Square Enix’s FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE brings cinematic pixel art and strategic battles to the cloud, and The Elder Scrolls Online’s Echoes of Skyrim Season adds the entire Greymoor Chapter free for all ESO Standard Edition owners. It’s all part of six games joining the GeForce NOW library this week. Deployment Without the Downloads Squad up and answer the call on the cloud. Activision and Infinity Ward’s Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches today on GeForce NOW. items.fullText: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure Google Cloud A5X instances, accelerated by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, support European innovators with next-generation agentic and reinforcement learning infrastructure. October 21, 2026 by Uttara Kumar 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! General availability of the instances is coming next month, with planned expansion of availability to Europe — bringing an integrated platform for training, inference and large-scale reinforcement learning to cloud customers. A5X instances bring together NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network and Google Cloud’s fourth-generation advanced liquid-cooling technology for demanding agentic inference and reinforcement learning workloads at scale. Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites. Ineffable Intelligence , a London-based technology company founded by AlphaGo creator David Silver, was the first customer to access A5X. Ineffable is using the platform to advance large-scale reinforcement learning and shape “superlearner” systems that learn continuously from experience. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Learning through interaction requires a continuous cycle of generating experience, evaluating outcomes and updating models, requiring infrastructure that can support the entire process at scale.
